_comment: Catalog of plugins and MCP servers offered by /init-project. Single source of truth — edit this to change what the picker offers. 'plugins[].id' uses the exact name@marketplace string that goes into settings.json 'enabledPlugins'. 'mcpServers[].config' is copied verbatim into the project's .mcp.json (supports ${VAR} / ${VAR:-default}). Optional 'suggest' preselects an item as a default: {"always":true} preselect everywhere; {"languages":[...]} preselect when any listed language is detected; {"signals":[...]} preselect when any listed signal is present. Signals: has-dependencies, git-remote, github-remote, web-frontend. Items with no 'suggest' are offered but never preselected. This catalog is the recommendation overlay, NOT the full universe — the picker lists everything actually installed (via 'claude plugin list') and floats these recommendations to the top. 'marketplaces' maps a marketplace name to its GitHub repo so a recommended-but-not-installed plugin can be registered and installed.

plugins.description: Drive Chrome DevTools for browser debugging.

github.description: GitHub MCP — issues, PRs, repos. Needs GITHUB_TOKEN.
